identificationModule.officialTitle: Adoptive Immunotherapy for Refractory/Relapsed Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma With CD19-TriCART Cells

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The tri-functional anti-CD19 chimeric antigen receptor contains an anti-CD19 scFv, a PD-L1 blocker, and a cytokine complex, enabling the CD19-TriCAR-T to simultaneously targeting the CD19 positive NHL cells，blocking the inhibitory PD-L1 signal and stimulating T/NK cell activation and expansion.
